ai_toolWebsiteVideoTitle: Create an introduction video from a URL
ai_toolWebsiteVideoDescription: Capture a website and create a narrated, captioned introduction, preserving its script, storyboard and editable project
ai_toolVideoMissingBrand: The capture has no usable brand color; provide brandColor and try again
ai_toolVideoWavRequired: Video narration requires WAV output with a verifiable duration; select a WAV-capable speech model

ai_toolsFieldPromptHelp: Describe the scene, style, and what to preserve or change in reference images.
ai_toolsFieldTextHelp: Enter the text to speak, within the selected model’s language and length limits.
ai_toolsFieldInstructionHelp: Describe the desired change, such as clearer wording, a shorter version, or a different tone.
ai_toolsFieldModelHelp: Optional configured model ID; leave blank to use the capability’s default model.
ai_toolsFieldFileHelp: Select an authorized WAV, MP3, or Opus file.
ai_toolsFieldReferencesHelp: Optionally select uploaded or generated images; select the target image for further edits.
ai_toolsFieldDocumentHelp: Select the Markdown or plain-text artifact to rewrite.
ai_toolsFieldContentHelp: Optional unsaved draft; leave blank to read the current document content.
ai_toolsFieldSelectionHelp: Optionally rewrite this exact excerpt; leave blank to rewrite the whole document.
ai_toolsFieldVersionHelp: For an existing draft, provide its read version; stop if the saved version changed.
ai_toolsFieldLanguageHelp: For example zh-CN, en, or ja; leave blank for the capability default.
ai_toolsFieldVoiceHelp: Optional provider voice name; leave blank for the model default.
ai_toolsFieldSpeedHelp: 1 is normal; values above 1 are faster and below 1 are slower. Model support varies.
ai_toolsFieldFormatHelp: Choose MP3 or WAV; the video workflow requires WAV to verify duration.
ai_toolsFieldSizeHelp: Optional pixel dimensions; supported sizes depend on the image model.
ai_toolsFieldWidthHelp: Even width; choose a 16:9, 9:16, or square frame within 1920×1080 pixels.
ai_toolsFieldHeightHelp: Even height; choose a 16:9, 9:16, or square frame within 1920×1080 pixels.
ai_toolsFieldTimestampsHelp: Optionally request segment or word timestamps; support depends on the transcription model.
ai_toolsFieldTargetDurationHelp: Optional model duration target; the video workflow separately verifies actual WAV duration.
ai_toolsFieldToleranceHelp: Optional allowed error around the target duration.
ai_toolsFieldUrlHelp: Public HTTPS website to introduce; deployment network policy still applies.
ai_toolsFieldGoalHelp: Optionally describe the audience, purpose, and main points to highlight.
ai_toolsFieldDurationHelp: 6 to 30 seconds. Narration that does not fit fails explicitly instead of being cut off.
ai_toolsFieldColorHelp: Optional six-digit hex color; otherwise use the captured website palette.
ai_toolsFieldCaptureHelp: Optionally select an existing capture.zip to skip website capture.
ai_toolsFieldStoryboardHelp: Select STORYBOARD.md or JSON; scenes with changed narration receive new audio.
ai_toolsFieldAudioReuseHelp: Optionally select WAV files in scene order; otherwise reuse or regenerate from the storyboard.
ai_toolSynthesizeExampleText: Welcome to our service. Tell me what you would like to do.
ai_toolVideoExampleGoal: Introduce the website’s main content and purpose in clear, concise language.
ai_toolsFieldImageWidthHelp: Positive image width up to 4096 pixels; available sizes depend on the model.
ai_toolsFieldImageHeightHelp: Positive image height up to 4096 pixels; available sizes depend on the model.
